from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class ExpenseEntry(BaseModel):
    """Operating and Administrative Expense reported in one company's filing for the period in question."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company the filing belongs to, as named")
    expense_label: str | None = Field(description="The line-item label as written (e.g., 'General and administrative expenses', 'Administration expense')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The expense amount as reported")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="Scale of the amount: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The period the figure covers")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt containing the label and amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    expense_entries: list[ExpenseEntry]
